title: Matched-pair harness running source and fused workflows on identical cases
question: Implementation target: a harness that runs each source workflow and each fused candidate on the SAME case with the same inputs, seeds and budget, recording per-run cost, wall-clock, terminal state and oracle verdict - so a comparison is a controlled experiment rather than two separate anecdotes.

declared_metric.estimator: binary case pass (required capabilities subseteq collected capabilities within harness-imposed budget); quality is a secondary continuous metric used only for the below-floor suppressor control

upstream.subject: WFA-0112 corpus and fusion-operator artifacts are absent on this Linux worktree. WFA-0113 runs a fixture corpus and fixture source/fusion workflows so the matched-pair contract is executable here. The harness would consume those artifacts unchanged when present.

oracle_score.method: max abs pairwise delta of two control runs of the same workflow on the same case (identical seed, budget, input hash)

quality.method: max abs pairwise delta of two control runs of the same workflow on the same case (identical seed, budget, input hash)

workflows.title: near-twin B (quality 0.51; below planted floor of 0.05)

tests.requirement: the variance floor must be measured before any comparison is reported
per pair, both arms run on the identical case with the same budget, verified by comparing the recorded input hashes
an arm that fails to run is recorded as a failed arm, never dropped from the comparison
budget parity must be enforced by the harness, not requested of the workflows
a difference between two workflows smaller than the variance floor is not a difference and must not be reported as one

reviewer.notes: Probe 2 re-runs the crash, hungry, and below-floor both-states controls without reading this artifact's answers. Probe 1 recomputes input hashes and checks control seq < comparison seq.

evidence.claim: A: per pair, both arms share input_hash of case+seed+budget. B: control arm runs the same workflow twice before comparisons; abs(delta) <= floor is classified not-a-difference.
Failed crash arm is retained; drop_failed mutant drops it. Hungry fusion is halted by the harness at budget_limit. Planted 0.01 vs 0.05 is not reported; 0.10 vs 0.05 is.
